The original article is therefore not generally unavailable. However R006 has not itself read its complete relevant original Methods/Results, source SRC-R006-E-STEVENS-INFORMATIVE@1 remains metadata_only with manifestations=[], and no manifestation-bound performed-reading AID exists. PubMed/institutional abstracts provisionally support E1–E6 for the paper but do not establish a final full-text eligibility judgment, exact stimulus/action coding, cohort independence, or numeric extraction. Full-text disposition pending (source-instance acquisition + actual reading + participant-overlap review), not inclusion and not an access-based exclusion. R005 receipt's original XML was ephemeral, not durably archived. The reported audiovisual and natural/symbolic conditions are within one publication; no independent samples inferred. R004/Integration should independently re-acquire lawful XML bytes, record edition/rights/time/hash and register source manifestation, then R006 performs qualifying reading, overlap adjudication and legitimate FT decision.
